name: sap-notes
description: SAP Notes and KBAs from me.sap.com: search for your release, read, correction code, SNOTE file and PDF. Through your session in the built-in browser, or its own background Chrome/Edge signed in with your SAP account.
long_description: A single self-contained Go binary. One read-only tool, sap_notes, with actions search, read, corrections, download and status. Two modes. browser (default): the server never contacts SAP; every action returns a short script that Claude runs on a me.sap.com tab of the built-in browser, where you are signed in. chrome: the server starts its own Chrome or Edge in the background with a separate profile, signs in with the SAP user and password from the settings, and saves .SAR files and PDFs straight into a folder; with two-factor authentication it opens a window for you to sign in.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: browser — scripts for the built-in browser of Claude Desktop, no credentials; chrome — own background Chrome/Edge with the SAP user below.

password.title: SAP password (chrome mode)
password.description: Kept in the system keychain by Claude Desktop. Leave empty to sign in by hand in a browser window.
